title: Privacy Suite not logging consents from Contact Forms
body:
### Steps to reproduce the issue
1. Enable the privacy suite plugins and have the Privacy Notice checkbox showing on Contact component email forms
2. User checks the "Privacy Note" check box.
3. User clicks the "Send Email" button.

### Expected result
The text alongside the Privacy Note checkbox says:
"By submitting this form you agree to the Privacy Policy of this website and the storing of the submitted information."  This reads as though the acceptance of the Privacy Note will be recorded/logged in /administrator.

### Actual result
There is no logging of the acceptance of the Privacy Note.

### System information (as much as possible)
Joomla 3.9.4
PHP7.2.15
Protostar template

### Additional comments
None
